National Security Starts with Science

Since its founding during the Manhattan Project, Oak Ridge National Laboratory has advanced the science and technology that protect the United States. To address modern and emerging threats to U.S. national security, ORNL translates scientific discoveries into technology solutions.

We bring together world-leading capabilities in nuclear science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, materials and manufacturing, cyber-physical systems, and geospatial data science to help the nation anticipate threats, strengthen resilience, and deliver mission-ready solutions. This integration allows us to move from fundamental discovery to deployable solutions—quickly, responsibly, and at scale.

The challenges are complex and the need for solutions urgent. But our approach is simple: start with science, integrate across disciplines, and deliver impact at speed and scale.

The Challenge We Face

An Evolving Threat Landscape

From emerging technologies and cyber-physical attacks to nuclear proliferation and supply chain vulnerabilities, the threats to America’s national security continue to evolve at a rapid pace. 

  • Nuclear proliferation risks and emerging advanced reactor technologies
  • Sophisticated cyberattacks targeting energy grids and critical infrastructure
  • Fragile global supply chains and foreign dependence for critical materials
  • Increasing natural disasters
